_comment: SAPM Alert Thresholds — paging and warning rules tied to SLOs and critical metrics. Reviewed and tuned for Alpha mainnet launch.

pagingRules.action: Page SRE on-call; declare SEV-2 if sustained > 10 minutes
Page SRE + Protocol Engineering on-call; halt new trade submissions if below 80%
Page Orchestrator Team on-call; review circuit-breaker state and provider lifecycle health

pagingRules.condition: Any circuit breaker transitions to open state
pagingRules.action: Page SRE on-call immediately; circuit-breaker open indicates dependency failure

pagingRules.condition: p99 forecast latency > 2000ms over a 5-minute window
pagingRules.action: Notify Orchestrator Team; investigate model service and provider health

pagingRules.condition: p99 forecast latency > 3000ms over a 10-minute window
pagingRules.action: Page Orchestrator Team on-call; begin incident response

pagingRules.condition: Provider lifecycle restart count exceeds restart budget within window
pagingRules.action: Page Orchestrator Team on-call; provider is fail-closed — investigate root cause before restart

pagingRules.condition: Frontend availability probe success rate < 99% over 10 minutes
pagingRules.action: Notify Frontend Platform team; begin investigation

errorBudgetAlerts.action: Freeze non-critical feature work; prioritise stability
Freeze non-critical feature work; prioritise stability
Escalate to incident commander; consider trade halt

testingNote: Alert thresholds are defined here and reviewed against SLO error budget policies in config/slo-definitions.json. Threshold values are tuned based on Alpha load profile and adjusted post-launch during hypercare window.
